Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Accounts Payable Accountant role based in Doha, Qatar. The Accounts Payable Accountant will process supplier invoices, verify supporting documentation, and ensure accurate and timely posting into the accounting system. This role includes reconciling vendor accounts, monitoring payment schedules, and preparing payment runs in line with company policies and cash flow requirements. The individual will resolve invoice and payment discrepancies by coordinating with internal departments and external suppliers, and maintain up-to-date records and reports for audits and management review. The role also involves assisting with month-end closing activities related to accounts payable and supporting continuous improvement of finance processes and controls.
q: Strong Finance and Accounting skills, with a solid understanding of basic principles and standards.
Proficiency in Invoice Processing and Invoicing, including verification, coding, and posting of supplier invoices.
Experience with Account Reconciliation, particularly vendor account reconciliation and resolving discrepancies.
Hands-on experience with ERP or accounting software and good MS Excel skills.
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
Detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Strong numerical aptitude and analytical skills, with a focus on accuracy and compliance.
Effective written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic language skills are an asset.
Previous experience in FMCG, distribution, or supply chain environments is preferred.

The position of the Waterpark Operations Manager, reporting to the Aquatics Director/Asst. Director, is responsible for the overall safety and satisfaction of both Guest and Team members at Meryal Waterpark. The below highlights the key responsibilities and duties that lie with the Waterpark Operations Manager along with the experience and requirements to obtain and maintain the position. The position of Waterpark Operations Manager must also possess and demonstrate technical skills as well as soft skills and character traits that will allow them to be successful in the role and responsibilities herein listed below. Above all, the Waterpark Operations Manager is passionate about waterpark operations and the prevention of loss of life due to drowning. They will oversee these processes with the objective of providing a safe, friendly experience for waterpark guests, and a fair working environment for employees.
